This page lists the posts in Stephen Skilton's DeckTech archive of tournament reports that do not have an article of their own on this wiki, and the reports that are published with short passages removed. Every post in the archive is accounted for here or in [[DeckTech tournament reports]], so nothing in the record is lost; each entry links to the archive (and its GitHub Pages mirror).

== Reports published with passages removed ==

These reports have their own articles. Reports are otherwise reproduced verbatim and uncensored; only sexual remarks about minors and a private street address are left out. Each removal is marked in the article's text and explained in its ''Note on this copy''.

* [[Danny Rider March 2001 Las Vegas tournament (before 8 March) report (tournament report)]] — A sexual joke about the tournament director, whom the report says was 16, and two jokes implying sex with a high-school girl were removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-08-vegas-in-my-pantsd1853/ original in the archive])
* [[Steve Baroni Playstation Parte (tournament report)]] — Four sexual remarks about a friend's sister and her friends, whom the report places at a high-school dance, were removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-14-playstation-parted1899/ original in the archive])
* [[Mike Gemme Worcester, England report (tournament report)]] — One sexual remark involving the author's sister, whom the report says is under 18, was removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-08-all-along-the-uterine-wall-5-6-englandd2262/ original in the archive])
* [[Mike Gemme Nipples Academy Where Is My TR (tournament report)]] — Three sexual remarks about girls who were minors (two the author describes as 14 and 13 years old, and a friend of his under-18 sister) were removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-nipples-academy-where-is-my-trd2664/ original in the archive])
* [[Bradley Augsburger Normal Illinois The Saga Continues (tournament report)]] — One leering remark about a girl from the author's school, where he was a student, was removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-normal-illinois-the-saga-continuesd3044/ original in the archive])
* [[giles Haakon's Revenge 25-11-01 Melb Oz (tournament report)]] — Four passages making sexual remarks about girls the author describes as underage (two of them as 13 years old) were removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-25-haakons-revenge-25-11-01-melb-ozd3118/ original in the archive])
* [[Rypcord Kline Twilight Games 12-15-01 Chase The Cans (tournament report)]] — Two lines accusing a player of sexual interest in the youngest (child) players, and one sexual remark about the author himself, who the report implies was about 15 years old, were removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-16-twilight-games-12-15-01-chase-the-cansd3177/ original in the archive])
* [[Jason Gillman March 2002 Dittmer tournament report (tournament report)]] — The posted title, a private street address, is not shown; the standings list itself is complete; the archive link points to the DeckTech report index because the report's own address contains the street address. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/ DeckTech archive index])
* [[Kevin Shannon Modesto CA 3-30 Strawberry Mama Action (tournament report)]] — One line that tied a sexual joke to the children playing Pokemon at the store was removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-03-modesto-ca-3-30-strawberry-mama-actiond3555/ original in the archive])
* [[Ryan French Wenatchee WA 3-30-2 Clone Wars E1only (tournament report)]] — A joke about a player ogling 15-year-old girls and a piece of innuendo about two teenage girls in the store were removed, because the wiki does not publish sexual content about minors. ([https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-06-wenatchee-wa-3-30-2-clone-wars-e1onlyd3560/ original in the archive])
